name: run_tests
description: Run the workspace test suite with fixed probes (cargo test / python -m pytest / npm test). Does NOT accept arbitrary commands. Returns exit code, pass flag, duration and output tails.

profile.description: Force a specific runner; omit to auto-detect (first match wins: cargo > pytest > npm)

extra.description: Extra args appended to the test command (e.g. a test-name filter). Max 16 items, each <= 200 chars.
